import sys, json, subprocess, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, topo, algo
rng=random.Random(4)
N=2048; T=1000; S=1000; Q=128
P=topo.period_rounds(T,S,Q)
links=[{'ends':[[(2*i)%N,0,0],[(2*i+1)%N,0,0]],'delay_ns':[rng.randint(1,100),rng.randint(1,100)],'defer_rounds':[rng.randint(0,2),rng.randint(0,2)]} for i in range(1024)]
slices=[[i for i in range(1024) if i%Q==q] for q in range(Q)]
fabric={'n':N,'interval_ns':T,'slice_ns':S,'offset_ns':0,'drift_ppb':[0]*N,
        'heat':[],'anchors':[[i,0,1] for i in range(N)],'links':links,'slices':slices,'blackouts':[],
        'guards_ns':[0,10,20,30,40,49],'reconfig_ns':0}
prof={'groups':1,'jitter_ps':[0],'measurements':[]}
plan=algo.compile_plan(prof,fabric)
print('guard',plan['guard_ns'],'peaks',plan['peaks_as'])
reqs=[{'op':'plan','profile':prof,'fabric':fabric},{'op':'audit','profile':prof,'fabric':fabric,'proposal':plan}]
inp='\n'.join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs)+'\n'
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=inp.encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
print('rc',p.returncode,'time %.1fs'%(time.time()-t0),'stdout MB %.1f'%(len(p.stdout)/1e6))
if p.stderr: print('stderr:',p.stderr.decode()[:300])
outs=[json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]
print('plan guard', outs[0]['guard_ns'], 'warmup', outs[0]['warmup_cycle'], 'rows', len(outs[0]['bounds_as']))
print('audit', outs[1])
EOF
